articles.title: Gudlyf Mobility builds the lightweight cylinders that hydrogen vehicles need to carry fuel
articles.text:
Gudlyf Mobility builds the lightweight cylinders that hydrogen vehicles need to carry fuel
The Madurai-based company designs and makes Type IV composite hydrogen cylinders rated to 700 bar for vehicles, gas distribution and industrial use.
Hydrogen has an awkward physical property. It holds more energy per kilogram than any other fuel and almost none per litre, which means a vehicle running on it has to carry gas compressed to hundreds of times atmospheric pressure. The tank stops being a container and becomes an engineering problem.
That is why cylinder design decides whether hydrogen mobility works. A steel vessel strong enough to hold 700 bar is too heavy to be worth carrying, and the weight eats the range the fuel was supposed to provide.
The industry's answer is the Type IV cylinder: a plastic liner that holds the gas, wrapped in carbon fibre composite that takes the pressure. It is the lightest of the four cylinder classes and the only one really practical for vehicles.
makes them. Incorporated in Madurai in October 2022, the company describes itself as developing Type IV hydrogen cylinders and storage systems for mobility, industrial and energy use, using what it says are proprietary materials and manufacturing processes.
Seven hundred bar, and as light as possible
The specification the company gives is 700 bar working pressure, which is the standard for fuel cell passenger vehicles. Getting there means the composite wrap has to be engineered for the shape of the vessel and the loads it sees, and then proved out through destructive testing: cylinders are burst, cycled and impact-tested until they fail, because a pressure vessel that fails in service fails violently.
Weight is the other half. The company frames its work around weight reduction for improved fuel efficiency and vehicle range, which is the whole commercial argument for Type IV over the heavier classes.
The markets it names run wider than cars. Oil and gas refineries and petrochemical plants need storage. City gas distribution networks need transport. Fuel cell vehicles, trucks, buses and locomotives need onboard tanks. And it lists aviation and aerospace, where hydrogen is being examined seriously and where weight matters more than anywhere else.
Its team is described as PhDs and specialists with a combined 120 years of experience in hydrogen storage, mobility and advanced materials, which for a company of four people means the experience is concentrated rather than distributed.
India has committed to building a hydrogen economy through the National Green Hydrogen Mission, and most of the attention has gone to producing the gas rather than moving and storing it. Storage is the part that decides whether any of it reaches a vehicle.
Awards, a university, and a very small business
The recognition it has collected comes from institutions rather than customers. It was part of the top 6 teams at the Carbon Zero Challenge run by IIT Madras and the JSW MG Motor India startup programme. It has also been an enabler at an SAE hydrogen student engineering event, and collaborates with Kalasalingam University in Tamil Nadu.
Gudlyf Mobility says it has developed and validated its cylinders and built its intellectual property entirely in India, which it presents as evidence that deep technology can be done here. No independent certification, customer or order appears in any public source.
The business behind it is small. Corporate filings record revenue of Rs 9.75 lakh for the year ended March 2024 and paid-up capital of Rs 1 lakh, with about four people. Funding has come across three rounds, none of them disclosed, with Startup India participating in April 2025.
There is also an earlier version of the company still visible. A separate Gudlyf website, last updated in 2024, describes a software business selling lithium-ion cell models built from accelerated lifecycle testing. That is a different product in a different industry, and neither site explains the shift.
(This story has been researched and compiled using publicly available information.)

articles.title: G.SKILL Pays Out $2.4 Million Settlement to DDR4/DDR5 Kit Buyers
articles.text:
Thursday, August 20th 2026
	
		
	
	
	
G.SKILL Pays Out $2.4 Million Settlement to DDR4/DDR5 Kit Buyers
G.SKILL has begun distributing payments between $20 and $25 to various customers after settling a $2.4 million class-action lawsuit. The lawsuit alleged that G.SKILL misled buyers of DDR4 and DDR5 memory kits about the actual speed of their DRAM kits. Filed in 2022, the lawsuit claimed that G.SKILL did not properly label its advertising materials and misled users into believing that the maximum speeds advertised for their memory modules were achievable only through XMP or EXPO memory overclocking profiles. Additionally, the lawsuit asserted that there were no warnings for consumers about the potential risks of memory overclocking, such as system instability or memory damage.
The DDR4 and DDR5 memory kits in the Trident Z and Ripjaws series were the focus of the class-action lawsuit. G.SKILL initially argued that it had properly labeled these products but eventually reached a settlement earlier this year, agreeing to pay $2.4 million in damages to the buyers of the original kits. Anyone who purchased G.SKILL DDR4 and DDR5 memory kits with speeds rated over 2,133 MT/s or 4,800 MT/s, respectively, from January 31, 2018, to January 7, 2026, is eligible to receive a settlement.The exact dollar amount each person receives varies based on the number of kits and the specific kit specifications purchased. Some social media posts report payments of $19.68, while others mention receiving $24.60. G.SKILL is also updating its packaging, online product listings, and advertising to clearly indicate that although the memory modules can reach certain speeds, they must be overclocked using Intel's XMP or AMD's EXPO technology to achieve their maximum speed.

articles.title: Du nutzt USB-Sticks nur als Speicher? Diese anderen Funktionen solltest du kennen
articles.text:
Du nutzt USB-Sticks nur als Speicher? Diese anderen Funktionen solltest du kennen
Einen USB-Stick im Homeoffice in greifbarer Nähe zu haben, lohnt sich. Denn so kannst du schnell Daten auf den Stick werfen, um sie extern zu sichern oder sie von A nach B zu bringen, ohne den kompletten PC oder Mac mitschleppen zu müssen. Doch damit endet für die meisten Nutzer:innen auch schon die Nützlichkeit von USB‑Sticks. Doch das ist nicht alles, was die kleinen Helfer können.
USB-Stick partitionieren
Wie schon erwähnt, nutzen die meisten ihren USB-Stick als einen großen Ordner, in dem alle Dateien ihren Platz finden. Es gibt maximal noch verschiedene Unterordner, die sich oftmals aber auch nur dann ergeben haben, weil ein kompletter Ordner auf den USB-Stick geschoben wurde. Dabei bieten die Sticks eine clevere Möglichkeit, deine externen Dateien besser zu sortieren und zu strukturieren.
Der Trick lautet in diesem Fall „Partitionierung“. Im Grunde teilst du damit die Gesamtkapazität des Speichers in mehrere kleine Bereiche auf. So werden etwa aus einem USB-Stick mit 512 Gigabyte Speicher vier Partitionierungen mit jeweils 128 Gigabyte, die allesamt als eigener Stick behandelt werden können. Das ist auch die Grundlage für viele der weiteren Tipps, die wir hier für dich zusammengestellt haben. Sobald du den USB-Stick partitioniert hast, kannst du einen Teil für Dateien nutzen, während ein anderer etwa deinen PC entsperrt und wieder ein anderer portable Programme abspielen kann.
Einen USB-Stick zu partitionieren, ist recht simpel, unterscheidet sich aber je nach Betriebssystem. Stecke zunächst den USB-Stick in deinen Mac oder Windows-PC ein. Unter Windows öffnest du das Startmenü und gibst in die Suche „Datenträgerverwaltung“ ein. Wähle das Programm aus und du siehst eine Übersicht aller verbundenen Festplatten und deren Partitionen.
Wähle den USB-Stick mit der rechten Maustaste aus und wähle „Volumen verkleinern“. Über den Assistenten kannst du jetzt festlegen, wie groß die erste Partition sein soll. Hast du die Partition erstellt, siehst du unten im Bereich der Datenträgerverwaltung die angelegten Speicherbereiche als unzugeordnete Blöcke. Klicke mit der rechten Maustaste darauf und wähle „Neu zuordnen“ und folge den Anweisungen des Assistenten.
Unter macOS rufst du hingegen das Programm „Festplattendienstprogramm“ auf. Wähle dort den Stick in der Übersicht aus und klicke dann oben auf „Partitionieren“. Klicke dann im Kreisdiagramm auf das Plussymbol, um eine Partitionierung hinzuzufügen. Du kannst der Partition einen Namen, ein Format und eine Größe geben, bevor du sie schließlich mit „Anwenden“ festlegst. Klicke dann nur noch auf „Partitionieren“ und folge den letzten Anweisungen des Tools.
Wichtige Dateien auf dem Stick verschlüsseln
USB-Sticks gehen von Natur aus schnell verloren. Sie sind zwar klein und handlich, verschwinden dafür aber gern in den Untiefen von Rucksäcken oder werden schlichtweg irgendwo liegengelassen. Das ist nicht nur wegen des Sticks selbst ärgerlich, sondern auch, weil damit alle wichtigen Dateien weg sind. Gerade wenn es um den Transport von sensiblen Daten geht, lohnt es sich deshalb, selbige zu verschlüsseln.
Geht der Stick verloren, kann er so nicht mehr einfach von den Finder:innen ausgelesen werden. Deine Daten bleiben also trotz des Verlustes sicher. Nur die wenigsten USB-Sticks dürften von professionellen Hacker:innen zufällig gefunden werden, die sich dann an die Entschlüsselung setzen würden. Um Geräte, Speichersticks oder auch einzelne Partitionen unter Windows zu verschlüsseln, gibt es ein Tool des Bundesamtes für Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik (BSI). Gpg4Win steht kostenlos über die Webseite des BSI zum Download bereit und kann dann über das Kontextmenü mit Rechtsklick aufgerufen werden, sobald eine Datei oder eine Festplatte ausgewählt wird.
Apple bietet für macOS ein eigenes Verschlüsselungstool an. Klicke dazu mit gehaltener Control-Taste auf die Datei. Im Kontextmenü wählst du „… verschlüsseln“ aus, wobei die Punkte für den Dateinamen stehen. Im Anschluss kannst du noch ein Passwort festlegen und den Vorgang starten. Bei beiden Methoden kann es je nach Größe des Sticks zu längeren Wartezeiten kommen.
Portable Programme immer dabei
Neben Dateien finden aber auch komplette Programme auf einem USB‑Stick Platz. Portable Programme müssen nur auf den Stick geladen werden und können dann von dort aus gestartet werden. Es bedarf keiner Installation auf dem Endgerät, in dem der Speicher steckt. So kannst du dir etwa Tools zur Fehleranalyse auf den Stick installieren und auf jedem anderen Gerät nutzen. Oder du kannst auf fremden Systemen deinen Lieblingsbrowser nutzen, ohne ihn erst installieren zu müssen.
Die Liste der portablen Programme für USB-Sticks ist lang. Eine ausführliche Liste mit sämtlichen kostenlosen Tools findest du etwa auf Portable Apps. Dort können die jeweiligen Programme direkt heruntergeladen und auf dem USB-Stick installiert werden. Die Betreiber bieten sogar einen eigenen Download-Manager, der quelloffen entwickelt wird. Darüber lassen sich eigene Sammlungen erstellen, die mit wenigen Klicks auf USB-Sticks oder sogar in synchronisierten Cloud-Diensten genutzt werden können.
PC entsperren per USB-Stick
Normalerweise werden die meisten Windows-Systeme durch eine PIN oder ein Passwort entsperrt. Auch Windows Hello mit Fingerabdruckscan hat sich bei einigen Modellen schon etabliert. Tatsächlich können aber auch USB-Sticks für mehr Sicherheit bei deinem Windows-Gerät sorgen. Du kannst einen Stick als Sicherheitsschlüssel einrichten. Solange der Stick im USB-Slot eingesteckt ist, funktioniert der PC reibungslos. Wird er herausgezogen, wird der Zugriff gesperrt.
Um einen Sicherheitsschlüssel anzufertigen, benötigst du nur den USB-Stick und das kostenlose Tool USB Raptor für Windows-Systeme. Das Tool legt eine kleine Datei auf dem USB-Stick ab, die zur Entschlüsselung genutzt wird. Der Vorteil: Da die Datei so klein ist, kannst du den Stick auch noch für andere Dinge weiternutzen. Du musst nicht einen kompletten USB-Stick opfern, um ihn als Schlüssel nutzen zu können.
Für macOS gibt es keine kostenlose Methode, um einen solchen USB-Schlüssel anzufertigen. Du kannst zwar Tools wie Rohos Logon Key herunterladen und damit USB-Sicherheitsschlüssel unter macOS erstellen, allerdings gelten sie auch lediglich für Windows-Systeme. Wer seinen Mac schützen will, muss zu einem kompatiblen, käuflich erwerbbaren Sicherheitsschlüssel zurückgreifen. Welche Modelle sich für dein Gerät eignen, zeigt Apple in einem Support-Dokument.

articles.title: CXMT planned to use stolen Samsung IP to develop its DRAM, court hears — former Samsung engineer who jumped to Chinese memory maker now behind bars
articles.text:
CXMT planned to use stolen Samsung IP to develop its DRAM, court hears — former Samsung engineer who jumped to Chinese memory maker now behind bars
Steal process recipe, get your DRAM on the market faster.
ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT), China's largest maker of dynamic random access memory (DRAM), planned to obtain Samsung's IP related to its memory process technologies in a bid to develop its own production nodes, according to testimony given in a South Korean criminal case involving leaked Samsung technology, reports Maeil Business. The company's managers allegedly had no intention to develop an in-house process technology from scratch, so obtaining IP from Samsung was a strategic decision.
The intention was a key part of CXMT's business plan rather than an opportunistic attempt to acquire Samsung's technology after the start of its own DRAM process development, according to the testimony of a former Samsung engineer identified as Jeon, who worked at Samsung for 28 years before jumping ship to CXMT sometimes around 2016. This April, Jeon was sentenced to seven years in prison for illegally obtaining a 600-step Process Recipe Plan (PRP) information concerning Samsung's DRAM fabrication processes in general and the 18nm-class node in particular.
"From the beginning, CXMT CEO and CTO tried to develop DRAM by stealing Samsung Electronics' Process Recipe Plan (PRP) information," Jeon told the court this week, according to Maeil Business. "CXMT had no research institutes or facilities at the time of its establishment, and had no intention of developing technology through its own research."
Copying the recipe does not automatically give you a working process. Nonetheless, a detailed process recipe can dramatically shorten development of any production node because it reveals things like the sequence of steps, deposition or etch conditions, anneals, cleans, implant parameters, temperatures, pressures, tool types, and so on. For a memory process, a ready process recipe can remove a huge amount of trial-and-error and reveal how the process integration is supposed to work. Meanwhile, even to ensure that the recipe works as intended, one needs to obtain the same or compatible tools as well as adjust their characteristics accordingly.
However, while a process recipe can potentially help to ramp any fabrication technology, a process recipe itself does not necessarily reveal the complete transistor architecture or physical design. For that, perpetrators also want things like cross-sectional structures, masks/layout information, design rules, device dimensions, capacitor geometry, process window, and so on. Such details are not easy to get for a brand-new fabrication technology, but they can be obtained by reverse engineering of shipping products. By combining process recipe with reverse engineering, experienced DRAM engineers can reconstruct much of the technology. Meanwhile, process integration engineers can save years of trial-and-error with actual fab tools.
Normally, it takes DRAM companies around 3 – 5 years to design a process node from device development to yield ramp. For a new player, development time from scratch will probably be around five years rather than three unless pre-competitive IP is licensed or certain heavy-lifting is done elsewhere. In fact, the Maeil Business report claims it took Samsung five years to develop its 18nm-class node.
Meanwhile, CXMT began mass production of DDR4 SDRAM in 2019 using a 22nm-class node. Mass production of memory using a 18nm-class process technology began in 2023. Such a timeline raises a question of whether CXMT's 22nm-class G1 was derived/adapted from the knowledge of Samsung's process technologies and/or their process recipes, the more advanced 18nm-class node, or did the allegedly obtained Samsung IP primarily help CXMT develop the later 18nm generation? In any case, there is a court ruling that CXMT stole IP from Samsung to boost its own memory production capability.
Get Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.
Follow Tom's Hardware on Google News, or add us as a preferred source, to get our latest news, analysis, & reviews in your feeds.
Anton Shilov is a contributing writer at Tom’s Hardware. Over the past couple of decades, he has covered everything from CPUs and GPUs to supercomputers and from modern process technologies and latest fab tools to high-tech industry trends.

articles.title: This Iiyama ProGraphic 4K monitor is our first taste of IPS Black 2.0 panel tech
articles.text:
TechRadar Verdict
This is our first look at the latest high-contrast IPS Black 2.0 panel tech from LG. It's no substitute for OLED when it comes to black levels and HDR performance. However, thanks to deft calibration and a strong feature set, including excellent connectivity, this Iiyama display is a fantastic 32-inch 4K option for professionals and creatives.
Pros
- +Strong feature set
- +Good connectivity
- +Nicely calibrated
Cons
- -IPS Black 2.0 underwhelms
- -60Hz refresh
- -Limited HDR capability
Why you can trust TechRadar
In this age of OLED everywhere, all the time, what hope for a mere LCD monitor launching into the market? Actually, the new Iiyama ProGraphic HB3201UHSNP, a 32-inch 4K model, actually looks like a very compelling package for creative professionals, on paper.
It's built around LG's very latest IPS Black 2.0 technology, which offers much better contrast than any previous IPS panel tech. Maybe that will close the gap to all those OLED monitors with their perfect per-pixel lighting control?
The panel also comes with both HDR 400 certification and 99% coverage of the DCI-P3 digital cinema colour space, not to mention Pantone Validation for design and print workflows.
Then there's this monitor's impressive connectivity. Along with the usual HDMI and DisplayPort inputs, you get USB-C with 96W of power delivery and a three-port USB-A hub. If that's not exactly exceptional, there are also DisplayPort and USB-C outputs for display daisy chaining, plus a full KVM switch to help streamline the sharing of this display across two computing devices.
As for obvious shortcomings, well, it's limited to 60Hz, and as that HDR 400 certification implies, there's no local dimming. But, again, maybe that high-contrast IPS Black 2.0 panel means this monitor can get by without local dimming? If it can, and given its fairly attractive price for such a well specified productivity monitor, this new Iiyama is a dead cert for a high ranking among the best business monitors we've tested this year.
Iiyama ProGraphic HB3201UHSNP: Design and features
- Nicely engineered
- Good connectivity
- Daisy chaining capability has limitations
Panel size: 32-inch
Panel type: IPS Black 2.0
Resolution: 3,840 x 2,160
Brightness: 450 nits
Contrast: 3,000:1 (static)
Pixel response: 4ms
Refresh rate: 60Hz
Color coverage: 99% DCI-P3
HDR: DIsplayHDR 400
VESA: 100mm x 100mm
Connectivity: HDMI 2.0 in x1, DisplayPort 1.4 in x1, USB-C 96W PD in, DisplayPort out, USB-C out, USB-A hub x3
Iiyama's monitors are usually no nonsense to a fault when it comes to design. Aesthetic flair isn't exactly the brand's signature. The new Iiyama ProGraphic HB3201UHSNP doesn't obviously buck that trend with its sober, minimalist styling.
That said, with slim, symmetrical bezels on all four sides of that 4K IPS Black 2.0 panel and a slightly slicker looking stand than most existing Iiyama models, this new 32 incher looks more contemporary than we've come to expect from the Japanese brand.
Sign up to the TechRadar Pro newsletter to get all the top news, opinion, features and guidance your business needs to succeed!
Functionally, the chassis gets the job done, too, thanks to a sturdy, well built stand and outstanding connectivity. HDMI, DisplayPort and USB-C inputs are pretty much a given these days for a 32-inch 4K model at roughly this price point, which is currently £667 in the UK and likely around $800 when it becomes available in the US.
What you wouldn't automatically expect is a full KVM switch and support for display daisy chaining from the additional DisplayPort output. The catch with the daisy chaining feature, unfortunately, is that resolution and refresh support from the DisplayPort output tops out at either 2,560 by 1,440 at 60 Hz or 4K at 30Hz. The latter not really being a realistic option due to how sluggish and choppy it looks and feels.
It's a slightly odd limitation given you might expect a monitor with daisy chaining capability to support another display of the same specification. Still, there's a three-port USB-A hub, including two ports on the left bezel. So, connectivity is generally a very strong point.
Support for creative workflows is also pretty good thanks to Pantone Validation, which helps ensure color accuracy through the print pipeline, 6-axis color hue and saturation controls and numerous color space presets. For the record, it's all backed by a reassuring three-year warranty from one of the most respected brands in the display industry.
Iiyama ProGraphic HB3201UHSNP: Performance
- Nicely calibrated
- Crisp, clean font rendering
- Limited HDR capability
In performance terms, easily the most intriguing aspect of the Iiyama ProGraphic HB3201UHSNP is its IPS Black 2.0 panel technology. To put it into context, until the first generation of IPS Black LCD panel arrived from LG in 2022, most IPS monitors topped out at 1,000:1 static contrast, with some capable of 1,300:1.
IPS Black generation one upped that to 2,000:1. Now this new IPS Black 2.0 panel lifts contrast even further, to fully 3,000:1. That's on a par with many VA panels, which used to trade on their clearly superior contrast.
So, how much difference does IPS Black 3.0 make? Subjectively, it's relatively subtle. The Iiyama ProGraphic HB3201UHSNP is still pretty obviously an IPS monitor and some of that characteristic IPS glow still leaks through in black tones.
On a related note, this HDR 400 display lacks local dimming. Long story short, you're never going to confuse this monitor with an OLED panel and its perfect per-pixel lighting control.
This Iiyama is not truly capable of HDR visuals. That said, as the 450 nit brightness specification implies, this is a very punchy panel and in that regard—full-screen brightness—it wallops any currently available desktop OLED monitor.
It's also very nicely calibrated and includes a comprehensive list of color space presets in its OSD menu. That includes both DCI-P3 and Display P3, the latter being the default color space used by Apple Mac computers.
What's more, if you hook up to a Mac over USB-C, MacOS's keyboard brightness controls are supported by the monitor, which is a welcome refinement.
Another positive feature is the matte anti-glare coating. Glossy display panels are currently in vogue, especially for gaming. However, the heightened reflectivity they involve can be problematic in many professional settings.
The matte anti-glare coating Iiyama has gone for does a good job of reducing reflectivity without introducing any coarseness or sparkle to the image quality.
Perceived contrast is also good for a matte panel. Sitting side-by-side with the latest RGB-stripe OLED panel technology in the same 32-inch 4K format, which is meant to "solve" the problem of font rendering for OLED panels, it's notable that this conventional LCD panel still has slightly crisper, cleaner text.
That said, if super sharp fonts are your thing, you might want to think about picking up a 6K 32-inch display, which can now be had under $1,000 / £1,000 on occasion.
Less impressive than the calibration, overall punch and visual clarity is the HB3201UHSNP's limitation to 60Hz refresh rate. The slightly sluggish response and juddery motion rendering is immediately obvious if you're used to 120Hz or above displays. Of course, high refresh is not a particular requirement for most pro creator workflows.
But it is an issue for daily sense of computing responsiveness and Iiyama should probably think about moving to 120Hz-plus across the range, or at least for non budget-orientated displays like this.
Iiyama ProGraphic HB3201UHSNP: Final verdict
If you know a little about panel technology and came in hoping the Iiyama ProGraphic HB3201UHSNP's IPS Black 2.0 technology might be revolutionary, the reality is more prosaic than that. It's a small, incremental step in lighting control and contrast performance, rather than a major leap. Put simply, OLED panels still rule for HDR visuals, black levels and viewing angles.
However, not only is the Iiyama ProGraphic HB3201UHSNP still a step forward for conventional IPS tech, it's also a strong overall package. It's nicely calibrated and well optimised for professional and creator workflows.
It delivers a strong connectivity feature set, too, including USB-C, a USB-A hub, KVM switch and even display daisy chaining, albeit the latter capability has limitations. This new model is also that little bit sharper and more contemporary looking in design terms than we've come to expect from Iiyama, which is a welcome refinement.
Really, the one obvious limitation is the 60Hz refresh rate. Strictly, 120Hz-plus refresh isn't a professional or creator workflow requirement. But it does make daily computing feel slicker and more pleasant. And it would elevate what is already a very good display into a great one.
For more creator displays, we've tested the best photo editing monitors and best monitors for video editing.
Technology and cars. Increasingly the twain shall meet. Which is handy, because Jeremy (Twitter) is addicted to both. Long-time tech journalist, former editor of iCar magazine and incumbent car guru for T3 magazine, Jeremy reckons in-car technology is about to go thermonuclear. No, not exploding cars. That would be silly. And dangerous. But rather an explosive period of unprecedented innovation. Enjoy the ride.

articles.title: BluHub, ce lecteur Blu-ray atypique, a levé 160 fois son objectif Kickstarter (mais prudence !)
articles.text:
Un graveur Blu-ray, un hub USB et un lecteur de cartes réunis dans un boîtier en aluminium pour 59 dollars : le BluHub a de quoi intriguer. Le projet cartonne sur Kickstarter, mais plusieurs éléments invitent encore à la prudence.
Le BluHub promet de lire et graver Blu-ray, DVD et CD, tout en faisant office de hub USB. Sa fiche technique annonce quatre ports USB-A, des lecteurs SD et microSD, de l’USB 3.2 Gen 2 jusqu’à 10 Gbit/s et une alimentation directement par USB. Le tout prendrait place dans un boîtier en aluminium de 409 grammes.
Le design de ce lecteur Blu-ray est aussi assez inhabituel. Le capot supérieur, inspiré selon son créateur d’un « grand piano », permet d’exposer un disque pendant qu’un autre est utilisé dans le lecteur. Un choix avant tout esthétique : le second emplacement n’a aucune fonction de lecture.
Un succès Kickstarter à relativiser
La campagne Kickstarter de BluHub a largement dépassé son objectif initial, avec plus de 160 fois la somme demandée à mi-parcours. Le chiffre est spectaculaire, mais il mérite d’être remis en contexte : l’objectif de départ n’était que d’environ 700 dollars.
Autrement dit, ce multiplicateur donne une image un peu trompeuse de l’ampleur réelle du financement. Pour un produit électronique destiné à être fabriqué et expédié à l’international, un tel seuil relève surtout de l’objectif symbolique. Cela ne remet pas nécessairement en cause le sérieux du projet, mais rappelle qu’un succès Kickstarter ne garantit ni l’industrialisation ni la qualité du produit final.
Plusieurs questions restent encore sans réponse
La principale inconnue concerne le mécanisme Blu-ray lui-même. Le créateur ne communique pas encore sa référence exacte, alors qu’elle permettrait de vérifier précisément les formats supportés, le firmware utilisé ou encore les capacités réelles en matière d’Ultra HD Blu-ray.
La compatibilité avec les appareils mobiles mérite également d’être nuancée. Le BluHub peut être reconnu via USB OTG sur certains terminaux, mais cela ne signifie pas qu’un smartphone ou une tablette pourra lire sans difficulté un film Blu-ray commercial protégé.
Même prudence concernant le tarif. Les premiers contributeurs peuvent réserver le BluHub pour 59 dollars, contre un prix public annoncé à 129 dollars. À ce niveau, la proposition est séduisante, mais elle reste celle d’un produit en financement participatif, avec les incertitudes habituelles sur les délais, la finition et le SAV.
Les premières livraisons sont annoncées pour novembre 2026. Le BluHub présente donc une idée intéressante et plutôt originale, surtout à l’heure où plusieurs grands fabricants réduisent leur présence sur le marché du Blu-ray. Mais pour l’instant, mieux vaut le considérer comme un projet prometteur plutôt qu’un graveur Blu-ray à 59 dollars dont toutes les promesses seraient déjà acquises.

articles.title: Claude Opus 5 scored 30% on ARC-AGI-3. Wrapped in Nvidia's AVO, it hit 100%.
articles.text:
Claude Opus 5 scored 30% on ARC-AGI-3. Wrapped in Nvidia’s AVO, it hit 100%.
Nvidia first introduced its Agentic Variation Operators (AVO) general-purpose coding agent system in late March 2026. The company has now unravelled the architecture and the system-level mechanisms that enable AVO to sustain long-running autonomous work and applied it to the open platform advanced AI reasoning benchmark ARC-AGI-3.
In a team blog released on Friday, a five-person team of Nvidia software engineers, machine learning specialists and AI research interns describe how AVO elevated Claude Opus 5 from a reported 30.2% model baseline score on ARC-AGI-3, to 100% when run as part of the complete AVO agent system.
“[This result] shows that system design – not model capability alone – can unlock frontier-level long-horizon performance,” wrote the team.
What tasks does Nvidia’s AVO handle?
Evolving from the core DNA of what constitutes an agent harness, AVO handles the agentic architecture tasks associated with inspecting and editing code, running commands, consulting documentation, and validating its work through execution. AVO’s distinguishing focus is said to be “sustained in-context autonomous operation” across extended, multistep tasks on long horizons.
Non-profit AI research and benchmarking body ARC Prize used an analysis post this July to report the 30.2% score for Claude Opus 5 at high reasoning effort on the public set of environments and tasks on the ARC-AGI-3 system. According to ARC Prize, this “demonstrates strong logical reasoning” and, when Claude Opus 5 was run at Max reasoning effort, it scores 97.5% on ARC-AGI-1 and 90.4% on ARC-AGI-2 semi-private.
The ARC-AGI-3 benchmark uses Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE), a metric that combines task completion with per-level action efficiency relative to first-time human baselines, where performance is aggregated across different levels and environments.
“AVO achieved a 100.00 RHAE score across all 25 environments in the ARC-AGI-3 public set, completing all 183 levels. The result illustrates a broader point: evaluating a model is not the same as evaluating an agent. Model capability matters enormously, but the surrounding system determines how effectively that capability can be converted into sustained autonomous progress,” stated the Nvidia blog team, headed by principal engineer Terry Chen.
“Model capability matters enormously, but the surrounding system determines how effectively that capability can be converted into sustained autonomous progress.”
How an agent decides on its next candidate
AVO was first demonstrated on difficult software engineering and GPU-kernel optimization tasks. In this work, AVO replaces what Chen and team describe as the “predefined variation step of conventional evolutionary-search systems” with an autonomous agent that decides how to generate the next candidate i.e. what to inspect, what to change, what to test, and what to commit.
The team used that work as a foundational research cornerstone to then progress to the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark.
“GPU-kernel optimization and the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark appear very different on the surface,” noted the Nvidia team. “One involves source code, compilers, profilers, and throughput. The other involves unfamiliar interactive environments in which an agent must infer the effects of available actions, discover objectives, and act efficiently enough to make progress. But the underlying computational pattern is similar. “
In both settings, the agent must:
- Build hypotheses from incomplete evidence
- Take actions through an external interface
- Observe the consequences
- Preserve useful state
- Revise its model of the problem
- Recover from incorrect assumptions
- Continue making progress over a long horizon
Preserving state and progress, reworking backwards past incorrect assumptions and working on long-horizon tasks beyond a single model’s context window with an incomplete picture of what’s in front of the system requires two specific mechanisms to be present in AVO: persistent memory and supervision.
“Preserving state and progress [and] working on long-horizon tasks beyond a single model’s context window with an incomplete picture of what’s in front of the system requires two specific mechanisms to be present: persistent memory and supervision.”
Persistent memory is used here to carry forward prior implementations, evaluation results, compiler and profiler outputs, and accumulated reasoning. It allows the agent to resume from the current state, instead of having to repeatedly reconstruct the search – exactly the sort of “sustained autonomous progress” that Chen and team have made their holy grail.
Supervision is also key; a supervisor (a programmatic software module within the AVO system, not a human in this case) monitors the broader search trajectory and can intervene when progress stalls.
Nvidia AVO paired with GPT-5.6 Sol
AVO is also designed to operate across frontier models. While the team’s full public-set result used Claude Opus 5, it additionally paired AVO with GPT-5.6 Sol on what it has classified as a “challenging subset of games” for further experimentation. In these tests, Sol reached matched levels faster in wall-clock time in several cases, while Opus used fewer environment actions in matched-level comparisons.
A quirky-sounding term perhaps, wall-clock time (obviously) refers to real world time as experienced by humans. It differs from CPU/GPU time, which may be divided by multiple cores (let’s say 8-cores) so that 80 seconds of compute time becomes 10 seconds of wall-clock time.
“These preliminary results suggest complementary operating profiles across models, and we leave a broader systematic comparison to future work,” noted Chen and team. “These results cover the 25-environment ARC-AGI-3 public set using the official scorecard and RHAE metric. They are not results on the semi-private or fully private competition sets.”
What the team learned from benchmarking AVO on ARC-AGI-3
The assembled engineers have said that the most important result was not simply the 100.00 score, but the fact that the same agent architecture transferred from highly specialized GPU-kernel optimization to a very different interactive reasoning task.
The team reminds us that in GPU optimization, feedback comes from compilers, tests, profilers, and performance benchmarks. In ARC-AGI-3, feedback comes from environment transitions and action outcomes. This means that, essentially, the interfaces differ, but the loop is the same i.e. the loop works to form a hypothesis, act, observe evidence, update state, and continue.
“This suggests that generality can come not only from domain knowledge, but from the machinery that allows reasoning and feedback to compound over time. More broadly, long-horizon capability is a property of the full system. Memory determines what survives, tools determine what actions are possible, feedback grounds progress, and recovery allows work to continue beyond a single model invocation,” concluded the Nvidia AI ensemble.
The Nvidia blog team in full included the above-noted Terry Chen, Nvidia director and distinguished engineer in competitive machine learning Jean-Francois Puget, VP of high-performance AI Humphrey Shi, and AI research interns Yeyin (Eva) Zhu and Zhifan Ye.
The team’s final words restate the crux of the investigation here: the model matters, but the model is not the entire agent.

Galaxy S25 fica mais barato com cupom para quem busca alto desempenho
Galaxy S25 (256 GB) tem chip Snapdragon 8 Elite e 12 GB de RAM; celular premium da Samsung sai por menos da metade do preço original no Pix com cupom
O Galaxy S25 de 256 GB está saindo por R$ 3.509 no Pix com cupom de 10% OFF disponível na página do Mercado Livre. O celular premium da Samsung equipado pelo chip Snapdragon 8 Elite e 12 GB de RAM recebe desconto de 53% sobre o preço original de R$ 7.499.
Embora não seja o menor preço histórico, esta é uma das melhores ofertas recentes de um celular topo de linha, que oferece alto desempenho por um preço acessível.
Mesmo após a chegada do S26, o S25 permanece um celular premium poderoso. Seu chip Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite e os 12 GB de RAM suportam apps pesados em multitarefa e soluções do Galaxy AI com tranquilidade. Os 256 GB de armazenamento permitem guardar uma quantidade razoável de fotos e vídeos.
A tela LTPO AMOLED Dinâmico 2X de 6,2″ tem taxa adaptável de até 120 Hz e brilho de até 2.600 nits, oferecendo reprodução de cores fiéis com alta fluidez nas transições, além de garantir a visibilidade em qualquer ambiente.
O corpo de alumínio Armor 2 conta com o vidro Gorilla Glass Victus 2 de ambos os lados, resistente a pancadas e quedas, enquanto a certificação IP68 confere proteção em cenários como poeira intensa e mergulhos acidentais.
O kit principal de câmeras do S25 filma em 8K e inclui wide de 50 MP com OIS e ultrawide de 12 MP, que tiram belas fotos em cenários abertos, e telefoto de 10 MP com zoom óptico 3x para boas aproximações. A frontal de 12 MP captura ótimas selfies e filma em 4K a 60 fps.
Sua bateria de 4.000 mAh resiste até 29 horas de reprodução de vídeo segundo a Samsung. O suporte a carregamento de 25 W via USB-C e de 15 W sem fio o permite resistir por muito tempo entre recargas, ideal para usuários com agendas corridas.
O Galaxy S25 de 256 GB (R$ 3.509 no Pix com cupom de 10% OFF disponível na página) foi atualizado para o Android 16 e ainda receberá mais seis updates de sistema operacional. O gadget possui conectividade 5G, Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 5.4 e NFC.

articles.title: Mejores móviles Oppo 2026. Cuál comprar y seis modelos recomendados
articles.text:
Tras una temporada en la que Oppo tuvo un conflicto de patentes con Nokia, la marca actualmente tiene un catálogo de móviles muy amplio con modelos de diferentes rangos de precio. Sin embargo, si tenemos que elegir el mejor, nuestra recomendación es el Oppo Find X9 Pro por todo lo que ofrece.
El Oppo Find X9 Pro es un móvil de gama alta-premium que destaca en muchos apartados. Es un smartphone bastante redondo, pero uno de los grandes atractivos se encuentra en sus cámaras que, junto con la compatibilidad del teleconvertidor, ofrece muy buenos resultados en su apartado fotográfico.
También es un teléfono que cuenta con una batería enorme que da para un par de días de autonomía, ofrece un gran rendimiento gracias a su procesador de MediaTek y su pantalla es una delicia, tanto por el panel LTPO como por el brillo que ofrece, tanto en interiores como en exteriores.
Los destacados
| MODELO |  | PERFECTO PARA TI | LO MEJOR | LO PEOR | PRECIO DESDE | 
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Oppo Find X9 Pro |  | Si buscas un gama alta-premium con buenas cámaras, batería grande y rendimiento excelente. | Tiene una muy buena versatilidad fotográfica y el rendimiento es excelente. | No tiene carga magnética y la cámara frontal no está a la altura de las demás. | 1.199€ | 
| Oppo Reno 14 5G |  | Si quieres un móvil muy equilibrado con puntos débiles salvables. | Su diseño es muy llamativo (y cómodo) y la autonomía da para un par de días. | A la pantalla le falta algo de brillo y tiene demasiado bloatware. | 459€ | 
| Oppo Find X9 |  | Si buscas un smartphone muy bueno en términos generales. | Su batería silicio-carbono ofrece mucha autonomía y el panel es exquisito. | Para tener un precio tan elevado, viene con bloatware. | 899€ | 
| Oppo A6 Pro 5G |  | Si quieres un móvil que cuente con buena autonomía y un precio muy ajustado. | Es cómodo en mano, muy resistente y tiene mucha autonomía. | Su rendimiento es bastante bajo. | 279€ | 
| Oppo Find X9 Ultra |  | Si buscas el mejor apartado fotográfico en la marca. | El sistema de cámaras es una gozada y el rendimiento es excelente. | El sistema para activar el teleconvertidor es incómodo. | 1.699€ | 
| Oppo Reno 16 F |  | Si quieres un móvil muy equilibrado. | Tiene ranura para tarjetas microSD. | El nivel de brillo, sobre todo en exteriores, es mejorable. | 449€ | 
Por qué destacan
De entre los distintos móviles que forman el catálogo de la marca, nos quedamos con el Oppo Find X9 Pro como el mejor representante. A continuación, haremos un repaso de las principales características en general para que tengas claro qué criterio seguir a la hora de comprar un smartphone.
Batería. Lo habitual es que encontremos buenas baterías en los móviles de Oppo. Esto es algo que vemos en las diferentes gamas, pero sobre todo en la media y alta. Lo que más suele destacar en estas baterías es la capacidad, encontrando bastantes opciones que superan los 6.000 mAh y ofreciendo autonomías que superan los dos días de uso.
Es importante señalar que cuanta más capacidad (mAh) tenga una batería, más carga rápida necesitaremos, sobre todo si buscamos que el móvil pueda recargarse al completo en poco tiempo. En cualquier caso, Oppo también ofrece una buena carga rápida en sus smartphone; muchos de ellos cuentan con 80W o más de carga por cable.
Sistema operativo. Los móviles de Oppo funcionan con Android bajo la capa de personalización ColorOS. Y justamente este es otro de los apartados donde más destaca, ya que la capa de personalización funciona muy bien: los móviles se sienten muy fluidos y ofrecen muchas opciones de personalización.
Cámaras. Algunos móviles de Oppo, sobre todo los de gama alta-premium, cuentan con cámaras muy solventes. El Oppo Find X9 y Find X9 Ultra, por ejemplo, ofrecen resultados fotográficos muy buenos, sobre todo si le añadimos el teleconvertidor de la marca.
Procesadores. El procesador de un móvil es clave a la hora de ofrecer un buen rendimiento y buena potencia ejecutando apps y juegos. Los más recientes también suelen ser más eficientes, por lo que contribuyen a conseguir una mejor autonomía.
Si tienes pensado exprimir el móvil jugando, el Oppo Find X9 Pro es una estupenda opción de compra gracias a que incorpora el procesador MediaTek Dimensity 9500. Si buscas un móvil con un precio más bajo, el Oppo Reno 16 F viene con el MediaTek Dimensity 7300, que está más pensado en ofrecer una mejor eficiencia energética que en la potencia.
Memoria RAM y almacenamiento. Nos encontramos ante una crisis de la RAM que ha afectado al precio de numerosos dispositivos, por lo que no es de extrañar que volvamos a encontrar configuraciones de memoria RAM y almacenamiento más comedidas.
De hecho, el Oppo Reno 16 F es el mejor ejemplo para tratar el tema, ya que es un móvil que viene con una configuración de 8 GB de memoria RAM. Además, incorpora una ranura para tarjetas microSD en el caso de que sus 256 GB de almacenamiento interno se nos queden cortos.
Otras opciones a considerar
Aunque te hemos recomendado el Oppo Find X9 Pro como el mejor móvil de la marca tanto por lo que ofrece como por su precio, hay alternativas dentro de su catálogo que pueden encajar mejor con lo que estás buscando. Aquí tienes las que nos parecen más destacables:
Oppo Reno 14 5G. El Oppo Reno 14 5G es el móvil más equilibrado de la familia Reno 14. Resulta atractivo porque es un móvil medianamente compacto con una pantalla de 6,59 pulgadas, pero también es interesante porque su batería tiene una capacidad de 6.000 mAh y viene equipado con el procesador MediaTek Dimensity 8350.
Oppo Reno14 5G
Oppo Find X9. El Oppo Find X9 es otro de los mejores móviles de la marca, y por varias razones. Por un lado, su batería de 7.025 mAh ofrece una autonomía de aproximadamente tres días. Por otro lado, viene con el mismo procesador que su modelo Pro. Además, su panel es exquisito y su diseño es muy cómodo en mano.
Oppo Find X9
Oppo A6 Pro 5G. El Oppo A6 Pro 5G también es un móvil que tiene un diseño muy cómodo en mano, y además es bastante resistente a los golpes y caídas. Su batería ofrece una autonomía de unos dos días de uso, la pantalla está muy equilibrada y viene con ranura para tarjetas microSD que puede resultar muy útil si queremos tener un extra de almacenamiento.
Oppo Find X9 Ultra. El Oppo Find X9 Ultra es uno de los mejores móviles de la marca y uno de los teléfonos con mejor apartado fotográfico en general. Es, por lo tanto, ideal para aquellas personas que busquen el mejor sistema de cámaras dentro de la marca, pero también resulta atractivo por su batería con capacidad de 7.050 mAh y por el procesador, que en este caso nos encontramos con el Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 de Qualcomm.
Oppo Reno 16 F. El Oppo Reno 16 F es un móvil con buena relación calidad-precio, y es que se trata de un smartphone que viene con un procesador bastante eficiente, una batería de 6.500 mAh y ranura para tarjetas microSD. Además, su diseño se siente bastante prémium y nos recuerda al del Oppo Reno 16 Pro.
Configuraciones y extras
Además de todo lo que hemos comentado anteriormente, a la hora de elegir un móvil de Oppo normalmente vas a poder elegir entre varias configuraciones, sobre todo de memoria RAM y almacenamiento. Además, también pueden venir o no con algunos accesorios:
Fundas. Algunos móviles de Oppo vienen con fundas. Lo habitual es que nos encontremos con fundas de silicona transparentes, aunque determinados móviles, como el Oppo A6 Pro, vienen con fundas de mejor calidad.
Cargadores. Los móviles no suelen venir con cargador, por lo que toca pasar por caja y comprar uno (si no tenemos ya) en el caso de que queramos aprovechar la carga rápida de los teléfonos de Oppo.
Memoria RAM y almacenamiento. A la hora de comprar un móvil podrás elegir la configuración de RAM y almacenamiento que necesites. Evidentemente, cuanto mayor sea la RAM y el almacenamiento, más caro será el móvil.
Preguntas frecuentes sobre el mejor móvil Oppo
¿Qué diferencias hay entre las gamas A, Reno y Find de Oppo?
La gama A reúne los móviles más económicos e la marca, la gama Reno ofrece una relación calidad-precio muy equilibrada y la gama Find representa la gama alta.
¿Los móviles Oppo sirven para jugar a videojuegos exigentes?
Sí, sobre todo los modelos de las gama Reno y Find cuentan con procesadores potentes para tener un buen rendimiento tanto a la hora de ejecutar apps como para jugar.
¿Cuánto almacenamiento necesito?
Lo mínimo que debemos considerar es una configuración de 256 GB para que así podamos guardar bastantes fotos, archivos y vídeos en local. Si pretendes hacer muchas fotografías, es recomendable apostar por 512 GB como mínimo. En cualquier caso, algunos de los teléfonos de Oppo vienen con ranuras para tarjetas microSD que permiten ampliar el almacenamiento del móvil.
Recomendación final
De entre las diferentes propuestas disponibles en el catálogo de la marca, nos quedamos con el Oppo Find X9 Pro por todo lo que ofrece. Es más económico que su modelo X9 Ultra, pero también ofrece muy buenos resultados fotográficos, es compatible con el teleconvertidor de Oppo y su batería ofrece una gran autonomía.
Sin embargo, es posible que estés buscando un móvil con diferentes características o que tenga un precio más ajustado. El Oppo Find X9 es un smartphone muy bueno en términos generales, su diseño es llamativo y muy cómodo en mano y además también tiene una gran batería.
Por otro lado, si buscas lo mejor dentro de la marca, el Oppo Find X9 Ultra es el teléfono con mejor apartado fotográfico y además ofrece un rendimiento excelente. Y si quieres algo diferente, el Oppo Reno 16 F es un móvil muy equilibrado y tiene ranura para tarjetas microSD.
Nota: algunos de los enlaces aquí publicados son de afiliados. A pesar de ello, ninguno de los artículos mencionados han sido propuestos ni por las marcas ni por las tiendas, siendo su introducción una decisión única del equipo de editores.

articles.title: Over The Top: WWI gratis en Steam: cómo jugarlo en PC por tiempo limitado
articles.text:
Lucha en batallas de hasta 200 jugadores con Over The Top: WWI, un juego ambientado en el crudo contexto de la Primera Guerra Mundial.
En Steam, se puede jugar gratis en PC por tiempo limitado: la promoción estará disponible hasta el 24 de agosto de 2026.
Para acceder, basta con ingresar a la plataforma y obtenerlo desde la página del juego para que quede asociado a la cuenta y disponible en la biblioteca.
PUBLICIDAD
Cómo jugar gratis Over The Top: WWI en PC por tiempo limitado
- Ingresar a Steam desde la app de escritorio o desde el navegador.

articles.title: Superman, le robot d'Unitree qui met Usain Bolt dans le rétro
articles.text:
Le lundi 17 août, Unitree a publié sur X une vidéo de 30 secondes coiffée d’un slogan sobre : « Breaking the Limits of Humanity ». On y découvre Superman, un prototype humanoïde développé en un peu plus de trois mois. Son fabricant le crédite d’une pointe de 45,6 km/h (12,66 mètres par seconde) et d’un saut vertical de deux mètres départ arrêté, le tout sur des jambes de 85 centimètres.
 Unitree New Robot Preview: “Superman” Breaking the Limits of Humanity🥳
 Standing high jump 2 m, top speed 12.66 m/s (0.85 m leg length)
 Surpassing the standing high jump and running speed records of all humans around the world
 This new machine has only been in development for a… pic.twitter.com/12i80ITU6p
— Unitree (@UnitreeRobotics) August 17, 2026
Pourquoi ce record tombe-t-il pile avant la Bourse ?
La vidéo sort un lundi, la cotation d’Unitree débute le mercredi 19 août sur le STAR Market de Shanghai, et la World Robot Conference de Pékin, grand-messe du secteur, se tient la même semaine. L’introduction avait déjà tourné à la démonstration de force : une tranche réservée aux particuliers sursouscrite 8 288 fois, record absolu de ce compartiment technologique. Unitree lève environ 905 millions de dollars, 45 % de plus que l’objectif initial, pour une valorisation proche de 9 milliards. Le tout à 36 fois les ventes de 2025, quand le rival UBTech, coté à Hong Kong, se contente d’environ 18 fois.
La démonstration boucle aussi une promesse publique. En mars, le fondateur Wang Xingxing prédisait que les humanoïdes dépasseraient les sprinteurs humains d’ici la mi-2026. Cinq mois plus tard, ses ingénieurs livrent la vidéo, au moment précis où les investisseurs sortent le chéquier. L’entreprise revendique par ailleurs 18 000 robots bipèdes livrés en cumulé à juillet, de quoi entretenir le récit d’un champion national de la robotique.
Usain Bolt est-il vraiment battu ?
Sur le papier, oui, et d’un cheveu. La référence commune est la pointe instantanée de 12,42 mètres par seconde mesurée sur Usain Bolt lors de son record du monde du 100 mètres en 2009. Les 12,66 m/s revendiqués la dépassent. La comparaison s’arrête là. Le chiffre sort d’une vidéo maison, sans la moindre mesure indépendante, et une pointe de vitesse ne fait pas un 100 mètres chronométré. Le temps de 7,90 secondes qui circule reste une extrapolation théorique, jamais un passage sur piste homologué. Le précédent invite d’ailleurs à la prudence, puisque le H1 de la même marque avait été flashé à 10,1 m/s en avril, marge d’erreur reconnue par Unitree elle-même.
La machine a de surcroît été taillée pour ce seul exploit. Superman n’a pas de mains, aucune capacité de préhension, et son constructeur le décrit comme une plateforme expérimentale dédiée aux mouvements très dynamiques. Le saut de deux mètres dépasse certes le record humain du Suédois Rune Almén, 1,90 mètre en 1980, mais il sort du même cahier des charges publicitaire. Quant aux limites, une seconde vidéo devenue virale les résume : lancé à pleine vitesse, le robot termine sa course dans une armoire électrique. Courir vite et savoir s’arrêter restent visiblement deux disciplines distinctes.
En attendant une homologation qui ne viendra sans doute jamais, retenez l’essentiel de la démonstration : les humanoïdes savent désormais nous distancer en ligne droite, tant qu’aucun obstacle ne se présente dans le virage.

articles.title: Cloud cost startup North adds Microsoft Azure to complete hyperscaler support - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Cloud cost startup North adds Microsoft Azure to complete hyperscaler support
Cloud financial management startup North Cloud Holdings Inc. today released North 3.0, a platform-wide update that adds Microsoft Azure and pulls cloud, artificial intelligence and data spending into a single system.
The release gives North coverage across all three major hyperscale cloud providers. Azure reaches general availability following a beta program, joining Amazon Web Services Inc. and Google Cloud Platform. North also added native integrations with OpenAI Group PBC, Anthropic PBC and Snowflake Inc., extending its tracking beyond cloud infrastructure to AI model and data platform costs.
The company is pitching the update as a response to how infrastructure spending has fragmented. As businesses spread workloads across multiple clouds while adopting AI services and modern data platforms, those costs have grown intertwined but are often still tracked in separate tools.
North 3.0 also introduces Autobot, which automates the buying and adjusting of cloud commitments. The tool spreads purchases into smaller monthly increments instead of committing to a large reservation upfront. The engine runs on machine learning. It tracks how much a customer is using and when commitments are due to renew, buying more when demand climbs and paring back when it falls.
Matt Biringer, North’s co-founder and chief executive, said the infrastructure customers manage “looks very different than it did even a few years ago.” Cloud spending, he said, “no longer stops at compute and storage. It includes AI models, data platforms, GPUs and multiple cloud providers.”
Other additions include generative dashboards that let users build views and surface insights in natural language through Noros AI, North’s FinOps large language model. The company also rebuilt its commitment management experience with more granular visibility, interactive simulations and planning tools for comparing savings strategies before buying.
Rightsize, North’s cross-cloud usage optimization feature, now extends to Google Cloud alongside AWS, with further providers planned. A separate tool for governing token usage, spending, budgeting and model health is in beta.
Based in New York, North raised $5 million in a Series A round led by Companyon Ventures last year.

articles.title: Back in 1996, Quake's shareware CD locked id Software's entire catalog behind flawed encryption that made it a free-for-all
articles.text:
DRM from the 90s: Thirty years ago, id Software tried to take advantage of the massive storage capacity of the CD-ROM format by bundling the studio's previous games with Quake. The system designed to manage this "unlocking" feature failed spectacularly, giving crackers and pirates an easy way to play all the company's games without paying any extra.
Quake recently turned 30, and id Software celebrated the milestone by releasing new content for the game's "enhanced" version. However, a more recent story highlights some of the unusual business decisions made by the Texas-based studio back in the 1990s. The game that broke id's old guard was also instrumental in making life much easier for pirates than it should have been.
According to a recent post by developer Fabien Sanglard, the Quake shareware CD contained many of id Software's previous games, which could be unlocked on demand. The idea was that gamers would "taste" the first level of Quake and then spend more money to either purchase the full game or buy one of the company's previous FPS releases.
Quake's game assets took up just 22MB of storage, Sanglard explained, which is why someone at id proposed using the remaining space to boost the studio's overall game sales. The company put a large portion of its back catalog on the Quake shareware CD, using encryption and a convoluted process that allowed customers to activate additional titles through a credit card purchase and a phone call.
The unlocking feature was provided by TestDrive, a company that specialized in "try-before-you-buy" technology for software released on "high-capacity" CD-ROMs. Needless to say, the system turned out to be deeply flawed and extremely easy to defeat. The Quake shareware CD arrived in stores on August 30, 1996, and a hacker group known as "Gnomon" released the "Quakecrk.zip" cracking tool just 39 days later.
According to Sanglard's analysis, the Qcrack.exe tool contained in the Quakecrk.zip archive was able to exploit weaknesses in TestDrive's encryption scheme to unlock the full version of Quake, as well as other id games included on the CD, such as Final Doom, Doom II, Hexen, Heretic, and Wolfenstein 3D. The unlocking system was seemingly designed to provide customers with a serial number over the phone, but the serial was merely proof of payment and contained no "secret" data at all.
Gnomon exploited this and other flaws in TestDrive's system to crack the CD's contents. The system wasn't even properly tested, as Final Doom could not be unlocked at all because of a bug in the code.
As recounted by David Kushner in his book Masters of Doom, the Quake shareware experiment turned out to be a disaster for id. After the crack appeared online and on BBS servers, the company was left with 150,000 pressed CDs piling up dust in a warehouse.

articles.title: Sagar Defence Engineering builds uncrewed boats that patrol and survey without anyone aboard
articles.text:
Sagar Defence Engineering builds uncrewed boats that patrol and survey without anyone aboard
The Maharashtra-based company makes unmanned surface vessels and aerial systems for the Navy, Coast Guard and energy sector, along with the autonomy software that runs them.
A patrol boat needs a crew, and a crew needs food, rest, safety margins and a reason to be at sea. For long, dull, dangerous work- surveying a seabed, watching a stretch of coast, checking a pipeline- the crew is the most expensive and most limiting part of the vessel.
Removing them changes the arithmetic. An uncrewed boat can be smaller, stay out longer, work in conditions that would be unsafe for people, and cost a fraction of what a manned equivalent does. India, with a coastline of over 7,500 kilometres and a large offshore energy industry, has a great deal of that work to do.
was founded in 2015 to build them. Its CEO, Captain Nikunj Parashar, spent more than a decade in shipping operations and commanded merchant ships before starting the company, alongside co-founder Mridul Babbar. It works from Pune and Mumbai.
Boats, drones and the software between them
The product range covers three things. Unmanned marine surface vessels operate on the water for survey, patrol and data collection. Unmanned aerial vehicles cover the air. Genesis is the autonomous navigation system that runs them, which is the part that turns a remotely operated boat into one that decides for itself.
The company describes its systems as embedding artificial intelligence and says they have been proven with the armed forces and internationally. Its named application areas run across defence, oil and gas, inland waterways, oceanography, disaster management and scientific research, with the Indian Navy, Coast Guard and border forces among the intended users.
Its stated framing is broader than any one product. Sagar Defence describes its purpose as accelerating the world's transition towards unmanned systems, which for a business selling into both defence and offshore energy is a way of saying the same hulls and the same autonomy serve very different buyers.
Its most visible demonstration was the Sagarmala Parikrama, an autonomous voyage completed in November 2024. A vessel making a long coastal passage without a crew aboard is the clearest proof that the autonomy works, because there is no one to intervene when it does not.
The company has also moved into partnerships rather than only products. In 2024 and 2025, it announced work with Liquid Robotics, the Boeing subsidiary that makes wave-powered autonomous surface vehicles, to scale unmanned surface vessel systems for maritime security.
Thirty million dollars, and a market forming around it
The funding record is substantial but inconsistent across sources. Company databases record between $30.1 million and $48.2 million raised across six to eight rounds, with the most recent described variously as a $25.4 million round in December 2024 and a Series B in March 2026.
The investor list is unusual for an Indian defence company. It includes ONGC, IDBI Capital Markets & Securities Limited, and Skegen as lead.
It also has revenue, which most companies in this field do not. Corporate records show about $4.68 million for the year ended March 2024.
Indian military technology funding has risen steeply over the past decade, and Sagar Defence sits among the handful of companies that have taken most of it. Its competitors are named in databases as Anduril, Saronic and Saildrone, all American and all operating at considerably larger scale, which is a fair measure of the company it now keeps and the gap it is working against.
(This story has been researched and compiled using publicly available information.)

articles.title: Une plateforme de gestion de rendez-vous médicaux piratée : 6,8 millions de profils volés
articles.text:
Nouveau jour, nouvelle cyberattaque en France. Alaxione, une plateforme notamment spécialisée dans la gestion de rendez-vous médicaux, a été victime d’une cyberattaque. Le hacker revendique le vol de 6,8 millions de profils. De son côté, Alaxione a confirmé l’attaque, tout en tempérant la situation. Si le vol de données confidentielles est confirmé, les risques pour les personnes concernées pourraient être notables.
Une plateforme de gestion des rendez-vous médicaux victime d’une importante cyberattaque
Un hacker revendique le vol de plusieurs millions de données personnelles issues de la plateforme privée d’organisation des agendas médicaux des praticiens Alaxione. Il assure avoir récupéré 12,8 Go de données, représentant environ 18 millions de lignes issues de plusieurs tableaux de la plateforme. Au total, 6,8 millions de profils auraient été volés. Selon le hacker, les données dérobées comprennent notamment : noms, prénoms, coordonnées, numéros de Sécurité sociale, professions, informations relatives au médecin traitant, coordonnées bancaires (IBAN, BIC), identifiants ou encore motifs des visites médicales.
Cette attaque aurait eu lieu la semaine dernière. Dans un premier temps, le hacker a tenté de négocier le rachat des données avec Alaxione, chose que la plateforme a refusée en bloc. Dans un second temps, face à ce refus, le hacker a mis en vente les informations volées pour un peu plus de 4 000 euros. Patrick Attaiech, PDG d’Alaxione, a confirmé l’attaque auprès de Franceinfo, tout en tempérant la situation. À noter qu’Alaxione a annoncé qu’un expert en cybersécurité allait évaluer ce vendredi l’étendue réelle du piratage.
Alaxione tempère la situation
La plateforme spécialisée dans la gestion de rendez-vous médicaux assure que l’attaque a ciblé un serveur de développement contenant des données de test, sans lien avec de vrais clients. En d’autres termes, le pirate ne détiendrait pas de données médicales réelles. Cette version est cependant remise en question par le site spécialisé Cyberattaque.org, qui affirme s’être procuré un échantillon de 1 000 lignes de données volées. Par ailleurs, des captures d’écran publiées par le cybercriminel montrent plusieurs bases de données accessibles depuis l’environnement de préproduction, contenant notamment de nombreuses adresses e-mail semblant correspondre à de vrais comptes. Ces éléments pourraient indiquer la présence de données réelles, sans toutefois permettre de le confirmer avec certitude.
Si le vol de données confidentielles est confirmé, les risques pour les personnes concernées ne sont pas négligeables. L’association d’un numéro de Sécurité sociale, de données médicales et d’informations bancaires pourrait permettre à des arnaqueurs de monter des pièges particulièrement trompeurs. Alaxione va maintenant devoir déterminer l’ampleur de l’attaque.

articles.title: Alexa+ costaba 20 dólares al mes. Amazon acaba de encontrar algo más valioso que la suscripción: meterla gratis en tu TV
articles.text:
Amazon llevaba meses intentando convertir Alexa+ en un producto premium. Ahora acaba de hacer algo llamativo: regalar esa tecnología. La compañía ha empezado a incluir Alexa+ sin coste adicional en todos los Fire TV compatibles de EEUU, incluso para usuarios que no están suscritos al programa Prime.
De 19,99 dólares/mes a cero. Hasta ahora fuera de ese programa el servicio costaba 19,99 dólares al mes, pero esta decisión hace que el servicio pase a ser absolutamente gratuito para los dispositivos compatibles en EEUU. La actualización que hablita dichas funciones está ya disponible en esos dispositivos, así que Amazon acaba de convertir automáticamente millones de televisores y dispositivos Fire TV en puertas de entrada a su asistente de IA.
La clave es estar en todas partes. Un chatbot de IA puede ser fantástico y aun así fracasar porque nadie se acuerda de usarlo. Era una espada de Damocles que pesaba sobre Alexa+, la teórica resurrección de Alexa que esperaba conquistar el mercado. Con esta medida Amazon impulsará sin duda el uso del servicio, porque bastará con hablarle a la TV para usarlo. En Amazon aseguran además que los usuarios de Alexa+ en Fire TV interactúan con este agente de IA el doble que con la versión anterior de Alexa.
Alexa, deja de decirme qué tiempo va a hacer. El nuevo asistente puede buscar películas y series con peticiones conversacionales, recomendar contenido según unas preferencias específicas o responder preguntas sobre o que aparece en pantalla, por ejemplo. En Amazon están intentando que Alexa deje de ser el asistente al que le preguntamos por el tiempo y se convierta en un compañero virtual que entiende el contexto y puede actuar sobre servicios y dispositivo.
Parece un regalo, pero es más que eso. Pero es que además de contestar a nuestras preguntas y peticiones, Alexa+ puede recomendar productos, facilitar compras y reforzar un ecosistema en el que Amazon ya gana dinero por muchas otras vías. Desde ese punto de vista, quienes usan Alexa+ todos los días pueden acabar siendo más valiosos que alquien que paga 20 dólares al mes pero apenas usa el asistente. La idea es sencilla: abaratas o regalas la capa de acceso a la tecnología porque eso acaba generando ingresos para el negocio.
Los modelos, que los desarrollen otros. OpenAI, Google o Anthropic están compitiendo por ofrecer los mejores modelos y agentes de IA, pero Amazon (de momento) no va por ese camino porque cuenta con una ventaja llamativa. Sus dispositivos Echo, Fire TV y su ecosistema doméstico ya están presentes en millones de hogares. Si la IA acaba siendo algo que usamos de forma cotidiana, esa distribución que ya está implícita en Amazon puede convertirse en una baza tan importante como la inteligencia del modelo.
Por ahora solo en EEUU. Amazon no ha anunciado que Alexa+ vaya a ser gratis de forma global ni que vaya a eliminar su precio en otros países. Sin embargo, la decisión deja una idea clara de sus prioridades: quizás Alexa+ no tenga que convertirse en otra suscripción de éxito para lograr ser rentable. En lugar de eso quiere demostrar que una capa gratuita puede generar más negocio que el que se planteaba con esa suscripción que antes era obligatoria para acceder a Alexa+.

articles.title: Ce changement discret chez Canal+ va faire grincer des dents les fans d'Apple TV
articles.text:
Canal+ ne propose plus l’accès gratuit aux contenus Apple TV avec ses formules d’entrée de gamme pour les nouveaux abonnés. Il faut désormais ajouter une option à 9,99 euros par mois, ou souscrire directement une offre à partir de 29,99 euros.
Depuis plus de trois ans, Canal+ offrait sans surcoût les séries et films d’Apple TV à ses abonnés, un partenariat scellé en 2023 qui simplifiait considérablement l’accès au catalogue de la Pomme. Cet avantage vient de connaître un coup d’arrêt discret, repéré par le compte Anaël sur X, bien renseigné sur les activités de la chaîne cryptée. Le petit logo Apple a disparu des deux formules les moins chères de Canal+, à l’occasion de l’ouverture d’une nouvelle période commerciale qui a débuté cette semaine.
Une option payante ou une formule plus chère pour conserver l’accès
Concrètement, les nouveaux abonnés à l’offre « Canal+ » ou à la formule promotionnelle « 100 % Canal+ » devront désormais ajouter une option Apple TV facturée 9,99 euros par mois s’ils souhaitent continuer à profiter du catalogue de Cupertino. Seule la formule « Ciné Series », facturée 29,99 euros par mois, inclut encore Apple TV sans supplément.
L'’écart tarifaire donne une idée concrète du changement : à 19,99 euros par mois pour l'offre Canal+ standard, contre 29,99 euros pour Ciné Series, il faut basculer vers une formule environ 50 % plus onéreuse pour conserver l’accès à Apple TV sans option additionnelle. Une addition qui pèse directement sur l’attractivité des formules d’entrée de gamme du groupe, et qui réduit du même coup la visibilité offerte à Apple auprès des nouveaux clients.
Les abonnés existants épargnés, pour l’instant
Les personnes déjà abonnées à Canal+ avant ce changement conservent l’accès aux programmes Apple TV dans les mêmes conditions qu’auparavant, sans supplément à payer. Canal+ n’a fourni aucune explication officielle sur les raisons de ce retrait, ni précisé si cette exception accordée aux abonnés historiques sera maintenue durablement ou s’il ne s’agit que d’une mesure transitoire.
L'’accord initial entre Apple et Canal+ avait permis, à partir de 2023, d’intégrer les contenus Apple TV+ directement dans l’application Canal+ (anciennement MyCanal), avant qu’une option ne soit ajoutée en 2024 pour y accéder également depuis l'application native d’Apple TV. Rebelote quelques mois plus tard avec une promotion réservée aux abonnés, cette fois pour Apple Music. Ce retrait partiel marque donc un coup de frein sur un partenariat qui avait jusqu’ici plutôt eu tendance à se renforcer au fil des mises à jour successives.

articles.title: Cómo pasar todos tus datos de un iPhone a tu nuevo Android de forma rápida y sin cables
articles.text:
Cambiar de iPhone a Android ya no es un proceso complicado ni está lleno de obstáculos técnicos. Hoy en día, es posible transferir todos tus datos (incluidos contactos, fotos, mensajes, aplicaciones compatibles y hasta el historial de WhatsApp) de forma inalámbrica, sin cables ni software adicional.
Con la integración de herramientas de migración en los propios sistemas operativos y la compatibilidad de los servicios en la nube, el salto entre ecosistemas se ha vuelto mucho más sencillo y accesible.
PUBLICIDAD
Aprovechar estos métodos permite conservar tu información sin perder tiempo, evitar errores y garantizar que tu nuevo Android esté listo para usarse desde el primer momento. Aquí te explicamos los pasos clave para lograr una migración completa, rápida y segura.
Antes de empezar: prepara tu iPhone y tu Android
- Carga ambos dispositivos para evitar interrupciones.
- Conéctalos a una red Wi-Fi estable. La transferencia inalámbrica requiere buena conectividad.
- Desactiva iMessage en el iPhone para evitar problemas con los mensajes SMS y MMS en el nuevo teléfono.
- Desbloquea el iPhone si tiene PIN, patrón o contraseña y considera desactivar el bloqueo automático durante el proceso.
- Revisa el almacenamiento disponible en el Android; la transferencia se detendrá si el espacio es insuficiente.
Si tu iPhone pertenece a una organización (empresa, escuela), es posible que existan restricciones de seguridad para transferir ciertos datos.
Qué se transfiere (y qué no) en la migración a Android
Se transfiere:
- Contactos, fotos y videos de la galería
- Calendario y eventos
- Mensajes SMS y MMS
- Historial de llamadas
- Aplicaciones compatibles (según disponibilidad en Google Play)
- Documentos almacenados localmente
- Cuenta de Google y configuraciones básicas
- Historial de WhatsApp (si eliges transferirlo)
No se transfiere:
- Aplicaciones que no existen en Android o que requieren licencias específicas
- Contraseñas almacenadas en el llavero de iCloud (deben exportarse manualmente)
- Datos cifrados de apps privadas o bancarias (requieren reinstalación y autenticación)
- Músicas, libros y películas comprados en Apple Store (salvo que sean compatibles)
Paso a paso: transferencia inalámbrica de datos
1. Enciende el nuevo Android y sigue la configuración inicial. En las primeras pantallas, el sistema te preguntará si deseas copiar datos de otro dispositivo. Elige la opción “iPhone o iPad”.
PUBLICIDAD
2. Vincula ambos dispositivos. Muchos modelos recientes muestran un código QR en pantalla. Escanea ese código con la cámara del iPhone para crear una conexión inalámbrica segura.
3. Selecciona los datos que quieres transferir. Elige qué quieres copiar (fotos, contactos, apps, mensajes, etc.) y confirma la selección. Si usas WhatsApp, el sistema te enviará una notificación para copiar el historial de chats.
PUBLICIDAD
4. Mantén ambos dispositivos conectados hasta que el proceso termine. Puedes seguir configurando tu Android mientras la transferencia se realiza en segundo plano.
5. Inserta la SIM física o descarga la eSIM en el nuevo Android si corresponde. Sigue las instrucciones del proveedor de telefonía para activar el servicio.
PUBLICIDAD
Qué hacer si no aparece un código QR
Si tu Android o iPhone no muestra un código QR, puedes iniciar la transferencia manualmente desde el menú “Copia de seguridad y restauración” o usando la app oficial “Cambiar a Android” de Google, disponible en la App Store. Elige la red Wi-Fi, accede a tu cuenta de Google y sigue las instrucciones para copiar los tipos de datos permitidos por este método.
Consejos adicionales para una migración sin tropiezos
- Valida la transferencia de WhatsApp: solo podrás migrar el historial si usas la función oficial y tienes ambas apps actualizadas.
- Revisa que todos tus contactos y archivos estén en su lugar antes de borrar tu iPhone o entregarlo.
- Actualiza el Android a la última versión para asegurar compatibilidad y acceso a todas las funciones.
- Si tienes problemas con la SIM o la eSIM, contacta a tu operador de telefonía para recibir ayuda personalizada.
Transferir datos de un iPhone a un Android es ahora un proceso rápido, seguro y sin cables adicionales. Seguir los pasos recomendados garantiza que tu información viaje completa y tu nuevo Android esté listo para usarse desde el primer día, sin perder nada en el camino.

articles.title: Fabricante paralisa produção de dispositivos Linux devido à crise de RAM • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Fabricante paralisa produção de dispositivos Linux devido à crise de RAM
Pine64 paralisou produção de notebooks, tablets e celulares baseados no Linux por causa da escassez e alta de preços de módulos DRAM e eMMC.
A Pine64 é conhecida por lançar placas de utilidade múltipla que concorrem, pelo menos até certo ponto, com os modelos da Raspberry Pi. Mas a empresa também é conhecida por lançar notebooks, tablets e até celulares baseados em Linux. Ou era: a companhia paralisou a produção desses últimos equipamentos por causa da escassez de chips de memória RAM e armazenamento.
Um comunicado a respeito foi publicado pela Pine64 no Telegram e no Mastodon. O começo do texto tem os seguintes dizeres:
Olá a todos! Só um lembrete rápido de que, devido à atual escassez de DRAM/eMMC, não há planos para continuar a produção de dispositivos Linux em um futuro próximo. A continuidade da produção dependerá da situação dos preços desses componentes após meados de 2027.
Pine64
A decisão afeta produtos como os tablets PineNote e o PineTab2. Ambos rodam Linux e contam com um teclado acoplável que os “transformam” em laptop. O PineTab2 também chama a atenção por contar com um processador do tipo RISC-V, o StarFive JH7110.
São produtos de nicho, portanto, e tão peculiares que é uma pena que a produção deles tenha sido prejudicada. De acordo com a Pine64, os estoques dos dois tablets devem durar mais três meses — isso se a produção paralisada não causar uma corrida por esses dispositivos.
No mesmo comunicado, a Pine64 explica que dispositivos baseados em microcontroladores, como as placas da marca, o smartwatch PineTime e o alto-falante inteligente PineVoice (também com chip RISC-V), continuam em produção.
A razão disso, presumivelmente, é o fato de esses dispositivos necessitarem de baixas quantidades de RAM e armazenamento. O PineVoice trabalha com apenas 32 MB de memória RAM e 16 MB de memória Flash, só para dar um exemplo.
O grande problema é que os custos com memórias alcançaram patamares exorbitantes e continuam aumentando. Esse cenário fez a Raspberry Pi aumentar os preços de suas placas várias vezes — ironicamente, elas foram desenvolvidas para serem acessíveis.
Para você ter uma ideia de como está a situação atualmente, só nos Estados Unidos, os preços das memórias DDR5 aumentaram em até 500% em apenas um ano, e outros tipos de RAM também estão sendo afetados pelo problema.
Consequentemente, não vai ser estranho se a Pine64 paralisar a fabricação de mais dispositivos ou, então, promover um aumento generalizado de preços.
